short_description: UK citizens vote to leave the European Union triggering immediate global market uncertainty.
US announces Section 301 tariffs on $50B+ Chinese imports initiating multi-year trade tensions.
WHO officially declares COVID-19 a global pandemic following rapid worldwide transmission and market turmoil.
Russian military forces launch full-scale invasion of Ukraine triggering energy and security shocks.
Regulators shut down Silicon Valley Bank following a sudden run on deposits sparking contagion fears.
Hamas launches large-scale offensive against Israel escalating Middle East geopolitical conflict.
Global market volatility spike and equity drop driven by Bank of Japan rate hike and carry trade unwind.
